method: Independent Node VM minimal-DOM regression harness with deferred mocked HTTP responses

checks.check: mounted QR and view retained during unchanged polling
late QR discarded after navigation away and back
late QR discarded after wallet metadata change
Transient failure marks stale details and recovers without QR replacement
wallet A replies cannot populate wallet B and a current refresh is queued
late pairing response discarded after logout
old 401 response preserves a newer login session

source_review: No blocking findings after the session and pairing metadata guards.
limits: The harness validates DOM identity and async state transitions, not browser layout or actual scroll position. Browser scroll verification is separate.
No live wallet state or user credentials were accessed by these tests.
